verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only developer building blocks: Graph APIs that external apps can call to automate Teams scenarios, bots and agents scaffolded with the Agents Toolkit and deployed to Azure, and incoming/outgoing webhooks. These are primitives a developer could use to build background automations. Nothing in the pack documents a user-facing capability to set up autonomous background automations, such as a built-in workflow or scheduled-agent feature, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.
